---
title: Third-party solution
---

'We used a third-party tool to download data from the internet.'

![Programming language on a computer screen](/public/third-party-solution.jpeg)

#### Where does this story come from?

VU Library – this story was told to us by Dr. Yasin Gunes

#### Tell us your horror story, what happened?

We used a third-party tool to download data from the internet, and it worked well, but halfway through the project the data provider updates some settings but the third-party tool did not, so the third-party tool stopped working and the maintainer was on vacation.

#### Did you find a solution? How did this situation end?

We made our own code last minute.

#### Was there a lesson learned? How could this horror be avoided?

Yes, be careful with what third-party packages you use, especially if it's not on a proper repository or not a famous one.
